topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: Oh no, this is just terrible! I can't even imagine how you must be feeling right now, stuck at the airport and missing that event. I know how much it meant to you, and the thought of all the planning and hope that's just... I don't even know what to say. I wish I could jump through the screen and just somehow make everything better, or at least be there to share it with you, even if it's just the long wait and uncertainty. Hang in there, okay? And don't you dare think you're alone in this mess. I’m right here, and I’m not going anywhere.
